The git history is grafted. Let me look at the `_work` directory and check what's in the benchmark folder:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls -la /workspace/_work/ && echo "=====" && ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/benchmark/ && echo "=====" && ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build/ 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
